csv_report.does: A runnable report tool: reads a CSV, groups rows by one column, totals another, prints the groups largest first. Tolerates blank and bad numbers.

data_validator.does: A runnable data checker: reads a CSV with name, email and age columns and reports every missing value, invalid email and impossible age, by line number. Exit code 1 when anything is wrong.

fetch_json.does: A runnable fetcher: downloads JSON from an http(s) URL and prints all of it, or one value picked by a dotted path like address.city or tags.0. Clear errors for bad URLs, failed requests and missing keys.

file_organizer.does: A runnable tidy-up tool: sorts a folder's files (say, Downloads) into images/, documents/, data/ and so on by file type. Shows the plan first (a dry run) and only moves files with --apply; never overwrites.

kv_store.does: A runnable settings/notes store: set, get, delete and list keys, saved to a JSON file between runs. One small function per command.

log_stats.does: A runnable log analyser: counts lines per level (INFO, ERROR, ...) and lists the most frequent error messages. Skips lines it can't read.

todo_cli.does: A runnable to-do app: list, add and done commands, saved to a JSON file. Six functions plus a main block.
